logistics-shipping.title: Logistics & Shipping - Oriented Facility Solution Pvt Ltd
paragraphs: An efficient logistics and shipping strategy is essential for reducing costs, streamlining operations, and supporting sustainable business growth. In today’s fast-paced global economy—driven by globalization and the expansion of emerging markets—understanding logistics as a service is more critical than ever.

Outsourcing logistics management goes far beyond simply arranging transportation. It involves a comprehensive service offering that may include warehousing, order processing, inventory management, packing, assembly or final assembly, and vendor coordination. These integrated solutions create a more agile and effective supply chain.

At OFS, our procurement consultants bring a deep understanding of sourcing best practices combined with extensive experience in vendor management. We work closely with your team to analyze existing sourcing processes, identify areas for cost reduction, and uncover opportunities for measurable improvement. Through a strategic approach to indirect procurement, we help you streamline operations, enhance value, and drive sustainable business growth.

Procurement and logistics are the starting point of the supply chain, involving the sourcing, storage, and movement of essential materials. Logistics experts help reduce costs by optimizing transportation and procurement processes, ensuring smooth operations and greater efficiency.

Think of Supply Chain Management (SCM) as the recipe, and logistics as just one ingredient. While both focus on moving goods from origin to destination, SCM provides the overall strategy for sourcing, production, and delivery. Logistics ensures that everything arrives at the right place, at the right time—executing the plan SCM creates.
A key part of supply chain management, logistics and inventory management involves planning the movement and storage of goods to ensure timely, accurate delivery to customers.
Larger organizations often face greater challenges, requiring precise control to maintain optimal stock levels. This prevents mismatches and ensures consistent customer satisfaction.
Shipping refers to the physical movement of goods, while logistics ensures that the entire process runs smoothly.

Logistics encompasses everything from planning routes to coordinating deliveries—ensuring shipments are efficient, timely, and cost-effective. For example, food delivery services rely on strong logistics systems to get meals to customers fresh and on time.

Transportation management focuses on planning and executing the most cost-effective movement of goods. It can operate internally or through a third-party logistics provider (3PL) for outsourced fulfillment.

As a key part of supply chain management, it covers all types of freight—domestic, international, inbound, and outbound. Effective transportation logistics requires strategic planning and smart procurement to ensure timely and efficient delivery.

Logistics focuses on planning and organizing the movement of goods, while distribution deals with their physical delivery and placement. Though distinct, both functions work together to enhance supply chain efficiency.
They also align with related activities like warehousing and inventory control—ensuring products reach the right place, at the right time, and at the lowest possible cost.

Refteck Solutions delivers a comprehensive approach to global logistics and supply chain optimisation. Our experts evaluate the entire process to identify cost and efficiency improvements—tailoring solutions to meet your unique operational needs.

We offer customised logistics services including storage, packing, and both domestic and international shipping. With our support, clients can accelerate product delivery, respond quickly to market demands, and improve customer satisfaction.
As your logistics management specialist, we simplify complexity—helping you reduce costs, scale operations, and enhance client experiences.
Here’s what you gain with Refteck Solutions:
End-to-end visibility across your entire logistics and supply chain process
Safe, secure transportation of all cargo—from delicate components to heavy machinery
24/7 customer support for real-time shipment tracking and issue resolution
Significant cost savings through optimisation of bulk material transport and route efficiency
Scalable solutions that grow with your business and adapt to market dynamics

How OFS Supports You in Spare Parts Procurement
paragraphs: A single missing component can bring your entire operation to a standstill. That’s why it's critical to maintain a steady inventory of the spare parts and resources your business depends on. Taking proactive care of your machinery ensures smoother operations—and ultimately, protects your bottom line. This is where a well-structured Spare Parts Procurement Plan becomes essential—enabling you to anticipate equipment needs and minimize downtime.
But what is spare parts procurement, and why does it matter?

Unlike basic purchasing—which focuses on placing orders, receiving parts, and processing payments—spare parts procurement is a comprehensive strategy. It involves the planning, sourcing, quality checks, logistics, and post-purchase support needed to ensure the right parts are delivered at the right time, every time.
By integrating procurement with international logistics, OFS helps clients maintain continuity, reduce operational risks, and extend the life of critical assets.

At OFS, we deliver efficient, timely, and end-to-end spare parts procurement services. Our logistics and supply chain experts manage the full process—from planning and sourcing to transportation, customs clearance, and storage. With our optimized supply chain strategy, we ensure you receive the right spare parts exactly when you need them.
With OFS as your procurement partner, you can maintain operational continuity and avoid costly downtime with a proactive and well-managed spare parts supply strategy.
Here’s what you gain with our spare parts procurement strategy:
Significant Cost Savings: Thanks to our experienced procurement team and strong vendor relationships.
Faster, Optimized Supply: Designed to eliminate delays and long lead times, ensuring uninterrupted operations.
Customized Solutions: You receive exactly what you need, how you need it. We work closely with vetted suppliers to offer flexible deals and delivery options.
Long-Term Price Stability: Through fixed-price contracts, giving you better financial control and planning.
Our support team is ready 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to handle your inquiry. You can use our enquiry form, email us, or call us.

In today’s fast-paced business environment—where efficiency and cost control are critical—OFS brings over 15 years of expertise in global spare parts procurement. Leveraging a trusted international supplier network, we deliver world-class technical support and sourcing solutions to clients across industries.
Our clients benefit from a streamlined, cost-effective procurement process that includes flexible sourcing options and full-spectrum Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) services.

At OFS, we take pride in supplying high-quality equipment and replacement parts at competitive prices. With our reliable procurement solutions, you avoid costly delays and ensure component availability when and where you need it most.

We simplify the entire process—from quotation to final delivery—ensuring transparency, timely updates, and zero surprises. With OFS, your transactions are monitored end-to-end, giving you complete peace of mind.
